text:
Leah (PM): ok team — quick sync on post-launch backlog. we have two clear signals: a sticky streaming disconnect bug (~3% of sessions) and a set of niceties (UX polish + better error copy). what's the minimal plan to keep SLAs while moving product forward?
Devon (Eng): 3% is noisy but root cause seems to be `kv-cache` eviction under burst. repro consistent in staging. likely a 1-day fix + canary.
Maya (Design): error copy and retry affordance would reduce support tickets, but it's mostly UX polish, not user-blocking.
Carlos (CS): customers reporting confusion and some churn risk. two enterprise accounts flagged this as highest priority.
Leah (PM): proposal: 3-day micro-sprint for hotpatch (investigate + patch + canary + roll) and a parallel grooming ticket for polish work to scope into next minor. agree?
Ravi (SRE): we should define rollback conditions and canary slice. suggest canary to 5% traffic in us-west for 4 hours, watch 95th latency and error spikes. if errors >2x baseline or latency > baseline+120ms, rollback.
Devon (Eng): ok. rough plan: Day 1 repro + fix, Day 2 QA + canary, Day 3 monitor + roll. owner: Devon.
Maya (Design): for the polish tickets I can draft copy and microflow for retry, assign to @Maya by EOW.
Carlos (CS): I can line up customer patches and offer workaround notes to the flagged customers today. will include reproduction steps in the support threads.
Leah (PM): scope limits: no model changes, no config experiments that change latency distribution. patch must be non-breaking and revertable.
Devon (Eng): quick patch diff will be small. plan to add guard around `kv-cache` eviction threshold and improve metrics. PR template:
```
fix(kv): throttle eviction under burst
- add eviction_backpressure metric
- add canary flag
```
Leah (PM): QA checklist for canary please: acceptance tests, regression checks for streaming ordering, token-loss tests, perf baselines. mark as required before 5% ramp.
Ravi (SRE): adding monitoring hooks: dashboard tile for eviction_backpressure, 5xx count by route, stream disconnect rate, tail-latency. alert for >1.5x disconnects.
Devon (Eng): will add logs + metric. estimated PR size small. tagging @Ravi for infra review.
Carlos (CS): once canary is green, I will coordinate a customer-facing note and update the status page.
Maya (Design): we'll keep polish UX in grooming: PRD for retry affordance + copy for errors — target next sprint.
Leah (PM): decision: prioritize hotpatch. backlog motion: move polish to "post-hotpatch grooming" with owner Maya + PM review. milestone: hotpatch shipped or rolled back by end of micro-sprint (3 days).
Devon (Eng): assigned owner label `owner:devon` and `hotpatch` tag in backlog. creating issue now.
TriBot: Reminder set: canary check at 4h after rollout (4932112000).
Leah (PM): thanks — weekly check-in after hotpatch completes. small follow-on: if hotpatch uncovers more systemic eviction patterns, we'll escalate to a small infra refactor epics. keeps us out of long-term risk. :thumbsup:
Carlos (CS): noted. I'll keep customers updated and escalate if any enterprise escalations come in.
Ravi (SRE): I'll prepare rollback playbook + runbook entry.
Leah (PM): perfect. closing thread — we all know next steps.
